_note: Resource use of the effects (memory and CPU), read by tools/effects.py. cpu_avg / cpu_peak are percent of the audio callback's time (100% = a block takes as long as it lasts; Show Debug and pedal_profile.py read libDaisy's CpuLoadMeter), each with a cpu_source; effects without them have not been measured, and CPU depends on the settings (see the source). Static figures are bytes per region measured from the object files (`tools/effects.py measure`). 'heap' is what the effect allocates with new (an effect's own entry has a heap_source): host estimates from tests/host/run_heap_report.sh, replaced by pedal measurements (tools/pedal_measure.sh -s) where there is one; the host count misses what global constructors allocate before main (PolyOctave, SciFi, the IR data: counted in their entries and in the impulse_response component) (the CloudSeed engine takes about 9 KB: measured for Jupiter on the pedal; the host count of 129 KB was far too high, see docs/PERFORMANCE_AND_MEMORY.md); null means not measured.

base._calibrated_with: the build of: autopan, chopper, chorus, cloudseed, compressor, crusher, delay, distortion, drum, dual_echo, flanger, geq, granular_delay, harmonic_tremolo, ir, looper, metro, modulated_tremolo, multi_delay, nam, noise_gate, overdrive, peq, phaser, pitch_shifter, polyoctave, reverb, scifi, spectral_delay, tape_delay, tuner
base.heap_source: measured on the pedal (tools/pedal_measure.sh -s, 2026-10-28): Uranus alone used 15,760 B of which Uranus 12,840, so about 2.9 K for the hardware module, the UI pages and the base effect module (0.7 to 4.5 K over the configurations measured, the UI pages grow with the number of effects); was 18 K before, from a FunBox build
base.cpu_callback_source: the audio callback with no effect, pedal_profile.py 2026-10-28: 2.3% (1.5% on the FunBox builds); subtract it from an effect's cpu_avg for the effect's own cost

cmsis_tables_4096._source: approximate: the 2048-point complex FFT twiddles and bit reversal plus the 4096 real-FFT twiddles (build reports: +42 KB with the FFT code)

impulse_response.heap_source: measured on the pedal (tools/pedal_measure.sh -s, 2026-10-28): three global objects in ir_data.cpp (lines 120, 237, 239: 4,104 + 4,104 + 8,240 B) allocated before main, whenever the component is built (IR, NAM, Mars)
